name: loki.enrich

arguments.name: forward_to
arguments.description: List of receivers to send enriched logs to.

arguments.name: target_match_label
arguments.description: The label from discovered targets to match against, for example, "__inventory_consul_service".

arguments.name: targets
arguments.description: List of targets from a discovery component.

arguments.name: labels_to_copy
arguments.description: List of labels to copy from discovered targets to logs. If empty, all labels will be copied.

arguments.name: logs_match_label
arguments.description: The label from incoming logs to match against discovered targets, for example "service_name".
